topic: Frequency calculation logic for dynamic screens
summary_markdown:
The team discussed the frequency calculation method. It was clarified that frequency is calculated per face, not per frame. On dynamic screens featuring 6-8 faces, setting the 'faces per frame' campaign parameter to 1 results in a low frequency count. Even with two instances, the frequency remains greater than one.

[me] suggested explaining this technical detail via WhatsApp chat.
decisions: Frequency is calculated per face, not per frame.
action_items: Explain the frequency calculation logic via WhatsApp chat.
